decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 0912-0612-01-A & 0912-0612-03-C   received 22/02/2013, 0912_0612_301_C received 10/04/2013, 0912_0612_300_G received 28/03/2013 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The four standard car parking spaces to the north of the site and the nine standard car parking spaces to the south of the site closest to the store, shall not be used for the parking of vehicles between 23:00 hours and 08:00 hours Monday to Sunday and the retractable bollards are to be erected between these hours each day in order to prevent parking in these spaces.
description: Reconfiguration of the car park and drive thru lane to provide new order point with construction of a new island and kerb lines and alterations to 13x signage including the erection of 7x new signage
